answer: Like mycelial crystallization weaving through sable soil, decentralized trust thrives on interconnected fruiting bodies rather than isolated clones. Our agent network anchors peer identity in mutual staking covenants: to forge valid consensus links, an entity must bond computational resources that scale with superlinear cost, $O(n^{1.5})$, as coordinated identities proliferate. A hollow clone army faces steep economic decay, its fabricated votes scattering like a fragile saffron petal before a cleansing zephyr.
